faq.accountQ: Do I need an account to book?
faq.accountA: No. Book with your name and phone number. An account lets you see all your bookings in one place and ask for weekly games.
faq.cancelA: Yes, up to the cutoff the venue sets. Refunds go back to the card you paid with.
faq.findQ: I lost my confirmation. How do I find my booking?
faq.findA: Open Find my booking and enter your reference and phone number.
faq.langA: Yes. Switch language from the top of any page, for players and for staff.

fee.intro: What you charge for each online booking. Walk-ins and bookings already made are never charged.
fee.fixedHint: Charged in each owner's own currency: 50 means ৳50 on a BDT venue and $50 on a USD one.
fee.percentHint: Of court time plus extras, up to 50%.

payer.ownerHint: The player's price stays the same.
payer.playerHint: Added to the player's total at checkout.

general.exampleOwner: Court {{base}} → player pays {{base}}, owner owes you {{fee}}
general.examplePlayer: Court {{base}} → player pays {{total}}, owner owes you {{fee}}

errors.fixed: Enter an amount above 0 and up to 1,000,000, with at most 2 decimals.
errors.percent: Enter a percent above 0 and up to 50, with at most 2 decimals.
errors.number: Use a Bangladesh mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.

payout.walletsIntro: Owners can send what they owe to these numbers. Only the wallets turned on here are offered to them.

stripe.title: Card (Stripe)
stripe.intro: Your own Stripe account. Owners pay by card and the money goes to you.
stripe.needKeys: To switch the mode or turn card payments on or off, enter that mode's keys again with Replace keys.
stripe.removeHint: Owners can no longer pay by card.
stripe.noKey: Locked: this server has no encryption key, so Stripe keys cannot be saved.
stripe.webhookHint: In Stripe, add an endpoint with this URL and subscribe it to these events, once in test mode and once in live mode.
stripe.webhookSecretHint: From the Webhook endpoint in this mode. Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.
stripe.modeNotConnected: Add the keys for this mode first.

sports.title: Sports
sports.intro: Sports switched on show on the home page, in search and in the court forms, in this order. Switching one off keeps it on courts that already have it.
sports.none: Keep at least one sport on.

apply.title: List your venue
apply.lead: Tell us about your business. Once a platform admin approves it, you can add venues and take bookings.
apply.name: Business name
apply.nameHint: The name players see, e.g. your club or arena.
apply.currencyHint: Prices and payouts use this currency.
apply.review: We usually review applications within a day.
apply.live: Your business is live. Add your first venue.
